caption: The drawing contains a symmetrical composition featuring several distinct elements. At the top, there is a decorative cross with a red outline and yellow fill, accented by blue shapes in the center of each arm and yellow starburst patterns emanating from the base of the cross. Below the cross, a bow-shaped ornament is depicted, outlined in blue with an inner pattern of red and yellow dots, and a circular yellow and red center. On either side of the bow, there are two stylized wing-like shapes with a yellow base color and red-tipped ends. At the bottom of the composition is a large circle containing a geometric mandala pattern; the circle has a double outline of red and blue, and the inner mandala features alternating patterns in yellow, red, and blue, including petal and sunburst shapes radiating from a central blue and yellow circle. The entire drawing is set against a beige background with a textured, aged paper appearance.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
